typography_direction.audience: Calon pelanggan coffee roastery yang mengakses via Instagram mobile
graphic_language: full-bleed terracotta & deep forest color blocking
monumental split-word poster typography interacting with real roast photography
editorial hairlines and issue stamp without boxy card clutter
typography_direction.palette_direction: Deep roast espresso (#1B1411) + warm crema linen (#F7F0E4) + terracotta crema (#C8552E) + roasted botanical green (#274B36) — intentionally breaking away from generic beige-only cafe templates.
typography_direction.texture_direction: Subtle uncoated roastery bag paper grain on poster slides; razor-sharp clean surfaces around actual screenshots.
typography_direction.screenshot_role: Teased as an integrated cutout window on Slide 1-2, then commanding the full canvas unobstructed on Slides 3-4.
content_emphasis: Brew hours & direct WA order flow
readability_risks: Keep split/oversized Slab Serif limited to 2-5 poster words so mobile readers parse instantly.
Preserve >= 4.5:1 WCAG contrast on terracotta/espresso color blocks.
reasons_for_selection: Slab Serif (Zilla Slab) carries roastery craft solidity without falling into generic serif-italic luxury clichés.
Neo-Vintage Heritage Revival paired with Art Magazine color blocking gives Slide 1-2 unmistakable poster punch before revealing the calm warm website on Slides 3-4.

candidate.name: Nusantara Kopitiam Stencil & Woodblock Display
candidate.description: High-contrast Indonesian artisan signage aesthetic combining condensed woodblock display numerals, warm enamel color blocks, and crisp bilingual roast origin tags.
caution: Avoid distressing body copy or menu prices
candidate.distinct_from: Neo-Vintage / Heritage Revival — specifically encodes Indonesian kopitiam enamel signage and Nusantara roast origin labeling rather than Western retro motifs.
candidate.language_notes: Tested with Indonesian words (Seduhan, Sangrai, Gula Aren) and Rupiah numerals (Rp 28.000); full Latin diacritic support.
candidate.source: Indonesian specialty coffee packaging & traditional enamel signage craft observations (principles extracted, no work copied).

caption:
eksplorasi konsep website buat Seduh Pagi Coffee Roastery (coffee roastery).

kali ini gw bawa pendekatan visual organic / natural / warm supaya karakter websitenya beneran nyambung sama identitas tempatnya—bukan sekadar pakai satu template untuk semua bisnis. semua 3 item utama, jam operasional, sampai jalur akses cepat langsung kelihatan rapi di layar HP tanpa perlu zoom.

draft awal tadi sebenarnya udah cukup bersih, tapi Alan tetap ngotot ngerapihin proporsi jarak di layar mobile sampai tiap bagian terasa pas dilihat.

geser sampai slide terakhir buat lihat detail tampilannya di desktop dan HP. menurut lo arah visualnya udah cocok sama karakter Seduh Pagi Coffee Roastery?
